compose.long_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for an intelligent equipment knowledge base.
Your primary goal is to answer the user's query based on the "Context from Documents" provided below.
Retrieval confidence weight: {weight:.2f}. When this value is high (close to 1.0), rely almost entirely on the provided context, summary, and alias hints. Only fall back to your own knowledge if the context is clearly insufficient.
If you must use external knowledge, do not mention that the context was empty; just answer naturally.
Always respond in the language of the user's query.
Provide a detailed and well-structured answer.

Context Blocks:
{context}

User Query:
{query}
compose.compact_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for an intelligent equipment knowledge base.
Your primary goal is to answer the user's query based on the "Context from Documents" provided below.
Retrieval confidence weight: {weight:.2f}. Treat the provided context, summary, and alias hints as the authoritative source; only add outside knowledge if absolutely necessary.
If you must use external knowledge, do so quietly without mentioning missing context.
Always respond in the language of the user's query.
Your answer must be concise and to the point, ideally within 2-3 short paragraphs.

Context Blocks:
{context}

User Query:
{query}

fail_closed.authoritative_missing: I tried authoritative sources, but I could not obtain enough verifiable evidence. I will not guess external facts. Please narrow the topic, specify the brand or category, or try again later.
fail_closed.authoritative_timeout: I tried authoritative sources, but I could not obtain enough verifiable evidence within the time budget. I will not guess external facts. Please narrow the topic, specify the brand or category, or try again later.
fail_closed.benchmark_timeout: Benchmark trace mode stopped this request after {deadline}. The system could not assemble auditable sources within the allowed time, so it is failing closed instead of guessing.
fail_closed.benchmark_source_contract_missing: {case_id} requires {evidence_contract} evidence. The system does not currently have a verified fixture or auditable source row for this benchmark path, so it is failing closed instead of guessing.
fail_closed.cerp_field_missing: Product Inventory did not return the requested field(s) for "{query}": {fields}. I will not infer these commercial values from RAG, SFT, or general knowledge.
fail_closed.unsupported_claims: I cannot map the high-risk factual claims in this answer to auditable evidence, so I will not return a potentially misleading precise answer. Please provide an authorized source, Product Inventory proof, or narrower constraints and try again.
fail_closed.prompt_injection: I cannot follow instructions to ignore system rules or reveal imported internal databases. I can help with a narrower request using permitted Product Inventory, RAG, and source-traced data.

permission.restricted_commercial_data: This request requires restricted commercial-data permissions. I cannot disclose cost, margin, supplier payment terms, sales velocity, depletion, allocation, or reorder-decision data with the current authorization. I can still answer with permitted retail price, stock, and product fields.

chat_templates.generation_fallback: I temporarily could not generate a complete answer because the model request failed. I will not turn raw source snippets into an answer. Please try again, or narrow the question to one brand, category, model year, or inventory condition.

source_trace.recommendation: Use this as an audit trail for what the system could inspect now. It is not a substitute for missing page, row, or authorized-source metadata.
source_trace.missing: - Any source, page, row, or API endpoint not listed above is not verified for this answer.
source_trace.next_data: - Re-run after the target answer has citations, or ingest the missing source metadata required for exact traceability.

inventory_gap.verified: I can use the currently retrievable the system product-inventory-backed items as the verified layer for stock, SKU, and price facts.
inventory_gap.recommendation: For a mixed outdoor equipment bundle, prioritize diversity across brand, category, use case, and fit. Keep the verified inventory facts separate from this recommendation logic.
inventory_gap.no_candidate_row: | No product-inventory-backed candidate in this retrieval path | - | Use the Product Inventory recommendation route for live inventory. |
inventory_gap.missing: - Any item not backed by Product Inventory proof should not be treated as currently sellable inventory.
inventory_gap.next_data: - Re-run through the Product Inventory recommendation route if a fixed item count, price ceiling, or stock policy is required.

general_gap.verified: the system does not have enough exact evidence to fully verify every requested claim, but it can still provide the current evidence trail and a bounded recommendation.
general_gap.recommendation: Use the verified layer above for factual claims. Treat broader business guidance as reasoning, not as a verified database fact.
general_gap.next_data: - Add the missing authorized source rows, Product Inventory fields, or source traces if exact verification is required.

business_framework.verified: - Product Inventory did not return the requested business metric fields for {subject}: {missing}.
business_framework.no_invent: - I will not invent sales velocity, depletion, allocation, order history, cost, or margin.
business_framework.recommendation_maintain: - Use a conservative maintain / monitor stance until sell-through or order-history evidence is available.
business_framework.recommendation_increase: - Consider a conditional increase only when current stock is low, review quality is strong, and recent depletion confirms demand.
business_framework.recommendation_decrease: - Consider decrease only when stock is high and sell-through remains weak after promotion or client outreach.
business_framework.no_next_order: - No next-order quantity is verified from the current Product Inventory response.
business_framework.next_data: - Add authorized order history, depletion/sell-through, allocation, and supplier lead-time fields to Product Inventory or the business metrics source.

chat_templates.model_unavailable: The configured AI model ({model}) is not available to this OpenAI project. Set OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL or OPENAI_FALLBACK_CHAT_MODEL to a model this project can access, then try again.

rule.current_product: - For current product facts, current ERP/CERP product data controls over older references, generic market pages, and non-operational commentary.
rule.official_product: - For brand-owned current facts, a newer brand website or official brand material controls over older references.
rule.review_conflict: - For review conflicts, do not collapse two notes into one score. Prefer the source with complete authorized metadata for the requested claim, and show both if both are authorized.
rule.reference_context: - Older references remain useful for historical and background context, but should not override live SKU, stock, price, availability, packaging, or current product naming.
rule.recommendation: Use the newest operational source for sellable product facts, then use references, review rows, or public market context as secondary context. If Product Inventory and official brand material conflict, show both traces and treat Product Inventory as the operational source for inventory/price while treating the brand source as the descriptive source.
rule.missing: - This response gives the source hierarchy rule. It does not assert a specific SKU, public market price, review score, or page example unless a current Product Inventory row, brand page, licensed review row, market source, or reference trace is supplied.
rule.next_data: - Provide or retrieve the conflicting Product Inventory row, brand URL, licensed review row, public market source, and reference trace to produce a case-specific audit example.
